text: Hi friends, let's sing about our senses. Ready? Let's go. I can see, I  can hear, I can smell things and I can taste, I  can touch, I can do and learn so much. Five little senses help me  play. Learning, laughing every day. I can see the sun so bright.  I can see stars at night. I can see my teddy, too. I  can see both me and you. >> I can hear the birdie sing. Hear  the bell going. Hear the music loud and clear. So many sounds for me to hear. >> I can smell the cookies  bake. I can smell the flowers.

>> Some smell good and some not. know that my nose will always know. >> I  can taste the [singing] yummy pie. >> I can taste a French fry. >> Sweet  and sour, [singing] hot or cold. >> Taste is fun for young and old. I can touch my teddy bear. Soft and fuzzy everywhere. I  can touch the snow so chill. warm and cozy blanket. Still I can see,  I can hear, [singing] I can smell things far and near. I can taste, I  can touch, I can do and [singing] learn so much. All my senses one by one. Help me learn and have some  fun.
